# Maintained output and source-preservation reviews

These two complete frozen packets retain the actual page/KGX review and the independent issue628 attribute-fix acceptance. [inventory.json](inventory.json) binds every outer member, including hidden/ignored files, manifests, freeze proofs and original failed attempts. Every member was decoded and compared to its original bytes; no additional scientific or recursive-container acceptance follows from packaging.

The page/export review passed 2,742 checks. It accounts for the maintained source link and CREATE-history difference from the scratch preview, preserves all125 full edge payloads and20 scope clauses, and verifies104 record-local KGX nodes,101 SVG nodes,three taxa and148 references. All266 earlier record pages remain unchanged, and only the six expected aggregate files changed. Its16-archive count refers to the three earlier preparation groups, before these two review archives were added. No browser or pixel-level QA is claimed.

The issue628 successor passed3,776 checks. The exact staged-tree difference is one owner-local Git attribute file. All703 earlier proposed owners and223 native XML originals remain unchanged. The initial137 trailing-space diagnostics across72 files, original exit2, successor exit0 and initial failed uppercase-control assumption are retained. Git case-fold behavior is explicitly documented; all17 negative boundary controls pass. Issue628 remains open until verified merge.

Read the complete HANDOFF and REVIEW reports inside each archive for independence, reused scientific scopes and exact limits. Full maintained gates, canonical scientific review, publication and merge remain separate events. Copy a whole frozen packet to a new scratch owner before reproducing historical scripts.
